reapack.name: RegionForge.lua
reapack.desc: RegionForge — Hierarchical region creation & batch render

metadata.description:
Hierarchical region creation and batch render tool for REAPER.
Creates regions from your track folder structure with per-type wildcard naming (SFX, Music, Dialogue, Environment), then batch-renders them to organized output folders. All settings persist between sessions via REAPER ExtState.
Features: - Wildcard token naming: $prefix, $root, $parent, $bpm, $meter, $character, $questname, $line - UCS 8.2 naming mode per audio type: $catid, $fxname, $creatorid, $sourceid, $userdata - Direct render engine: WAV output without opening REAPER's render window - Four built-in audio types with independent configs - Live hierarchy tree preview on the Main tab - Batch render with region checklist, Select All / None / Filter by Type - Output path templates per audio type

version.author: Panchuel
version.changelog: - Direct render engine (AudioAccessor → WAV) that never opens REAPER's render window; 16/24-bit PCM or 32-bit float, engine selector in the Render tab (native REAPER render kept as fallback for other formats) - Async rendering with in-GUI progress; the UI stays responsive during batch renders - UCS 8.2 (Universal Category System) naming mode, toggleable per audio type: new UCS tab with Category/SubCategory pickers (82 categories, 753 CatIDs), CreatorID/SourceID/UserData fields and live filename preview - New wildcard tokens: $catid, $fxname, $creatorid, $sourceid, $userdata (usable in names and output paths) - Modular audio types: create/delete types from the tool (up to 8), each with its own prefix, pattern and output path - Custom per-type fields (up to 5) usable as wildcards, e.g. field "weapontype" becomes $weapontype; values edited on the Main tab - Selectable sample rate for the Direct engine (project / 44.1 / 48 / 88.2 / 96 kHz) - Fix: audio type dropdown now opens anchored to the box instead of detached at the mouse position - Fix: Open Folder and Browse no longer freeze REAPER (async shell) - Fix ReaPack source URLs after the repository folder move

version.author: Panchuel
version.changelog: - Add configurable base render folder (textbox + Browse button in Render tab) - Cross-platform folder picker: PowerShell/OpenFileDialog on Windows, osascript on macOS, zenity/kdialog on Linux - Non-blocking Browse dialog (REAPER stays responsive while picker loads) - Fix Open Folder button to launch Explorer/Finder without blocking - Fix base folder field: clearing it now resets to project default immediately
